profile_text.body:
Adobe is a public company founded in 1982 and headquartered in San Jose, CA. Its website, specifically the Adobe Express landing page, describes the product as an all-in-one design, photo, and video tool intended to make content creation easy, allowing users to produce social content, videos, logos, and more. The site also describes an AI Assistant 2 feature that lets users prompt, create, and edit content while preserving chosen elements across layers.

The site tracks four AI products under Adobe's umbrella. Adobe Express AI is described as a lightweight design tool with quick content creation capabilities and integration with Adobe Firefly. Adobe Firefly is positioned as an image generation product with a commercial-safe training claim. Premiere Pro AI covers professional video editing with features including generative extend and color match, also carrying a commercial-safe training claim. Adobe Podcast AI offers audio enhancement, speech enhancement, and a microphone check feature, likewise noted as commercially safe.

Adobe files with the SEC under CIK 0000796343 and trades on a public exchange under the ticker ADBE. Its most recent 10-K filing covers the period ending November 28, 2025, and reports revenue of $23,769,000,000. The held facts note 161 law-related exposure items associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded in the current data.
